This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Sofia's research applies game theory to understand evolutionary strategies in biocontainment scenarios. She develops models to predict how engineered organisms might evolve under various selective pressures and containment strategies.

Areas of expertise

Evolutionary Trajectories · Game Theory · Biocontainment

  • PhD in Mathematics (in progress) · ERA Berlin · Expected 2025
  • MSc in Mathematical Biology · University of Bonn · 2021
  • BSc in Mathematics · Heidelberg University · 2019

Research interests

  • Evolutionary game theory
  • Adaptive dynamics
  • Strategic evolution modeling
  • Containment strategy design

Publication records as supplied
